fixes: Player actor (after-spawn.png, after-near.png): the courier reads as a floating gray box torso with stubby arms, a tiny brown head, and no distinct legs — add leg/foot geometry contacting the sidewalk, defined shoulders, and a larger head so the character silhouette reads at chase distance.

Blue coupe shape (after-drive.png, after-near.png): the body is stacked disconnected slabs (roof, trunk lid, bumper) with dark wheels partly swallowed by the body and flat red taillight quads floating on the rear; rebuild as one hood-to-trunk volume with a tapered nose, wheel arches, and inset taillights.

Sidewalk composition (after-near.png): near-black boxes crowd the bottom-left and bottom-right corners and a lone pale post/hydrant sits mid-walk; snap props to a consistent sidewalk grid, delete the intruding dark cubes, and keep the camera corridor and framing clean.

World edge / horizon (before-drive.png, after-drive.png, after-spawn.png): the street dissolves into an infinite flat tan plane at the horizon; add distant skyline massing or an aerial-fog band to hide the playfield boundary.

Beacon and parcel finish (after-drive.png, after-spawn.png): the beam is a hard-edged additive slab that still grazes the right taillight — taper it, soften the base ring, and nudge it right so it never overlaps the vehicle outline; give the yellow parcel a contact shadow or low pedestal instead of hovering.
visual_review.summary: The beacon fix is confirmed in actual images. At the identical accepted replay t15.5, before-drive.png shows the tall green beam swallowing the blue coupe, while after-drive.png shows the car fully readable (roofline, rear window, both taillights) with the beam reduced to a thin sliver at the car's right edge plus a ground patch — the exact failure is gone. At the identical disposable wall-fixture t6.5, before-near.png is an unusable blank gray wall-in-face, and after-near.png is a usable street view with the player, coupe, and objective lane clearly framed; diagnostics report 0 camera-inside and 0 near-plane-intersection samples across all phases, matching the images (no clipping pierces the frame). after-spawn.png shows a readable ordinary chase view: player on sidewalk, coupe and yellow parcel visible, HUD legible. All ten mechanics/regression checks pass independently, and displacement/anchor facts are consistent. Remaining issues are art-quality only and outside this camera/beacon scope; the fixture does not accept the game.
